context_requirements: Functional SCN5A voltage-gated sodium channel expression
Neuronal or excitable-cell phenotype for canonical antitussive activity
For non-specific anticancer effects: RRAD expression (oxeladin/butamirate) or high oxidative stress susceptibility (bergenin), not expected in these lines at 10 uM
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h after 10 uM treatment in any of the nine lines
Enrichment of a coherent transcriptional signature (e.g., STAT3 target downregulation, DNA damage response, or cell-cycle arrest) shared across multiple lines
Dose-response relationship between drug concentration and transcriptional changes in these lines

evidence.supports: Suhuang antitussive capsule acts via IL-17/PI3K/AKT/NF-kB in a rat asthma model, not via SCN5A in human cell lines
Dextromethorphan is neuroprotective in hyperoxia models via pleiotropic mechanisms, not a defined transcriptional program in these lines
Oxeladin and butamirate inhibit GBM growth via RRAD-dependent STAT3 suppression, a context-specific anticancer effect
Dextromethorphan causes DNA damage and cell-cycle arrest in zebrafish, a non-mammalian developmental toxicity context
Bergenin has antitussive and anticancer activity via ROS/DNA damage, but is a natural product not representative of the SCN5A-targeted class
